Roasted Chickpeas
 
Save Print
Author: Maddy Simonsen
Ingredients
  • 1½ cups dried chickpeas
  • 1 tablespoon kosher salt
  • Topping ideas
  • 2 teaspoons paprika, 1 teaspoon cumin
  • 3 teaspoons sugar, 1 teaspoon cinnamon
  • 1 lime or 2 tablespoons lime juice, 2 teaspoons black pepper
  • 1 teaspoon cumin, 1 teaspoon paprika, 1 teaspoon chili powder, ½ teaspoon garlic powder, ¼ teaspoon salt, ¼ teaspoon black pepper (or 4 teaspoons taco seasoning)
Instructions
  1. Soak chickpeas for 24 hours with salt.
  2. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
  3. Heat the oven to 400 degrees. Dry the chickpeas extremely well using towels.
  4. Spread the chickpeas on a baking sheet. Drizzle 3 tablespoons of oil on the chickpeas if using the oven. Drizzle 1 tablespoon if using an air fryer. Roast for 20 minutes, and then start shaking every 5-10 minutes. At about 30-35 minutes, the chickpeas start to get crispy. They are done when they are as crispy as you want.
  5. If using an air fryer, heat to 390 degrees and cook a single layer 15-17 minutes until brown.
